title_zh: 免費網上培訓：督導標準——選督導不等於選實習地點（11 月 19 日，1 CE）
title_en: Raising the standard for supervision Kate Walker webinar
summary_zh: Kate Walker Training 免費網上直播講座，由 Tara Fox 博士主講，主題是「提高督導標準：選督導不等於選實習地點」。講座針對輔導實習生與準督導，講解如何分辨選實習地點與選督導是兩個決定、面試督導時值得問的問題、簽督導合約前的警號，以及督導未盡責時實習生可以自保的策略，並比較 LPC、LMFT 與社工督導要求的差異。2026 年 11 月 19 日下午 5 時舉行（頁面未註明時區，主辦機構位於德州），全程線上，免費參加，可獲 1 小時繼續教育學分（符合德州 50% 要求，其他地區須自行核對）。
summary_en: Kate Walker Training offers a free live webinar, "Raising the Standard for Supervision: Because Choosing a Supervisor Isn't the Same as Choosing a Site", presented by Dr. Tara Fox. Aimed at counselling associates and prospective supervisors, it covers how choosing a site differs from choosing a supervisor, questions worth asking in a supervisor interview, red flags before signing a supervision contract, and strategies for getting quality supervision when a supervisor is not holding up their end, plus a comparison of supervision requirements for LPC Associates, LMFT Associates and social workers. It runs on 19 November 2026 at 5:00 pm (timezone not stated on the page; the organiser is Texas-based), fully online and free, with 1 CE hour (meets the Texas 50% requirement; other jurisdictions should check locally).

related.summary_zh: Telehealth Certification Institute 的「臨床督導論壇」是免費的線上直播系列，每場 1.5 小時 CE，APA、NBCC、ASWB ACE、NAADAC 等均有認可。2026 年 11 月 13 日（美東 13:00–14:30）由 Amie Bryant, LCSW, CAS, ACS 主講「Managing Difficulties in Clinical Supervision: From Concern to Remediation」，討論研究所訓練留下的落差，以及如何在不同能力階段支持受督者成長。
related.summary_en: Telehealth Certification Institute runs a free live Clinical Supervision Forum webinar series worth 1.5 CE per session (APA, NBCC, ASWB ACE, NAADAC and NY State approvals). The Nov 13, 2026 session (1:00–2:30 pm ET), presented by Amie Bryant, LCSW, CAS, ACS, covers managing difficulties in supervision from concern to remediation and supporting supervisees across competency stages.
